from steve import Model

"""Right-angle mounting bracket.

Coordinate system: millimetres, right-handed Z-up, origin at the minimum-X,
minimum-Y, minimum-Z corner. This editable single-part model implements R01-R13
for the CAD-creation stage. Geometry is the union of the specified base and
upright regions minus two plain cylindrical through holes. No fillets,
chamfers, counterbores, countersinks, text, logos, or auxiliary components are
included.

Predeclared downstream checks retained from the supplied specification:
T01 document isolation; T02 bounds/frame; T03 solid structure; T04 wall
thickness; T05 hole geometry; T06 volume; T07 editability/naming; T08 color
metadata. T09-T11 are separate capture, rendering, and review stages.
"""

model = Model("right_angle_bracket")

# Base region: X=0..60, Y=0..40, Z=0..6 mm.
model.box(
    "base_region",
    length=60.0,
    width=40.0,
    height=6.0,
    at=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    centered=False,
)

# Upright region: X=0..6, Y=0..40, Z=0..46 mm, joined to the base.
model.box(
    "upright_region",
    length=6.0,
    width=40.0,
    height=46.0,
    at=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    centered=False,
    op="join",
)

# Z-directed plain through holes anchored to the actual base top face.
model.hole(
    "base_hole_1",
    on="base_region.top",
    points=[(20.0, 10.0)],
    diameter=4.0,
    depth=6.0,
    kind="simple",
)
model.hole(
    "base_hole_2",
    on="base_region.top",
    points=[(45.0, 30.0)],
    diameter=4.0,
    depth=6.0,
    kind="simple",
)

# Supplied conditional presentation mechanism only; this does not establish
# mechanical, printing, manufacturing, mass, or strength compliance.
model.material("fdm-petg", finish="matte", color="#607d8b")

result = model.result()
